requiredSectionHints: Step-by-step actions using POM method names

mandatoryRules: File MUST import test and expect from @playwright/test
File MUST import at least one POM class from qa-framework/frameworks/playwright/pages/
All browser actions (click, fill, type, hover, check) MUST go through POM methods — no raw page.locator() or page.getByRole() for actions in spec file
Every test() block MUST contain at least one expect() assertion
No page.goto('https://...') — use relative paths and let baseURL from playwright.config.ts resolve the host
No hardcoded credential strings in .fill() — use process.env.SAUCE_USERNAME ?? 'standard_user'
No test.skip() or test.fixme() without a // @skip-reason: <explanation> comment
File MUST contain at least one console.log() call
console.log() calls MUST use [STEP], [NAV], or [ASSERT] prefixes for traceability
Each test() MUST have an AC traceability comment above it (e.g. // AC-1: ...)
Non-UI ACs MUST produce a notimplemented stub — never silently skip
ciGateRejectionReasons: Raw page.locator() / page.getByRole() action outside POM
test() block with zero expect() calls
